title: Close out the IINA plugin failures

questions.prompt: Which failures should this close-out fix?
questions.description: The audit found player bugs in bookmarks and a starter that never loads its menu or overlay. The June 2025 wishlist (i18n, drag reorder, markdown, themes, sharing) is separate.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Fix the bookmarks player path, the starter boot path, the docs that describe behavior the code does not have, and bump ghVersion so IINA can see the update.

options.label: Bookmarks: real file, time, and chapter; overlay can reopen; rejected adds do not toast success; typecheck and unit tests pass
Starter: Info.json globalEntry, load webviews after the window loads, show the overlay, relative webview script URLs
Docs and README match the code, including the dev symlink and the cloud-sync claims
Bump bookmarks to 1.2.0 and ghVersion to 2, without publishing a GitHub release

questions.prompt: What should happen to features that were never built?
questions.description: Duplicate resolution, collections, and scratchpad promotion have UI that is not mounted. i18n, drag reorder, markdown, and themes have no implementation.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Leave the unbuilt wishlist. Wire the duplicate-add path so a near match is visible instead of looking like a no-op. Do not build collections, i18n, drag reorder, markdown, or themes in this close-out.

options.label: Fix only broken existing behavior. Do not mount unused dialogs.
Also make a near-duplicate add visible. Leave collections and the rest of the wishlist.
Mount the dialogs that already exist: duplicates, collections, batch tag, and batch color.

questions.prompt: What counts as assured, given this machine cannot run IINA?
questions.description: Linux has no IINA app. Playwright can drive the webviews with a fake bridge. A real player check stays on your Mac.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Typecheck and the full Vitest suite must pass. Playwright covers the add, duplicate, and overlay-reopen paths. Call out the macOS IINA check instead of pretending it ran.

options.label: pnpm run type-check and make test must pass
Playwright covers add, duplicate, and overlay reopen
Document the manual IINA check and do not claim it was run here
